reason: Umbrella consolidation: fast-checks-gate (session-end check gate) and reconcile-done-when (clause-by-clause task audit) are one class of work, proving a claim of done. Folded both as labeled subsections. The reconcile checklist is carried as references/reconcile-checklist.md and pointed at from the body, since deleting the sibling archives its directory. Description shortened to fit the 60-char index budget.
Canny done-gate fired on the same three scratchpad files at every Stop for many turns; the agent kept restating "no check applies" and the gate kept blocking. Only deleting the files ended the loop.

The orchestrator repeated a builder's "17 of 20 tests passed" as its own result, and a later stop-hook check flagged the claim as unsupported because the last lint run had failed and nothing had passed since.
